name: Klaviyo
summary: A B2C marketing and CRM platform whose vendor documents three agent paths: a hosted MCP server (mcp.klaviyo.com/mcp) with over 300 tools that read and write profiles, segments, campaigns, flows and email templates, with query parameters for read-only, core-tools-only and scope-limited tool sets; a local MCP server run with a private API key; and a REST API with private-key or OAuth authentication. Account-bound: a keyless initialize answered 401 with a bearer challenge and OAuth discovery documents that name a dynamic-registration endpoint, which was not called.

payments.notes: 2026-11-07: no surface prices an MCP or API call in money. Pricing page: a free plan of 250 active profiles and 500 emails a month, Email from $20/month and Marketing from $25/month at 500 profiles; Personalization is an add-on priced on active profiles. Terms 6.3 authorize charging the card.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-11-07, no credentials: POST mcp.klaviyo.com/mcp initialize 401, WWW-Authenticate Bearer naming resource metadata; protected-resource and authorization-server documents 200 (code+refresh, PKCE S256, registration endpoint, not called). GET a.klaviyo.com/api/accounts/ 401.

jobs.summary: Vendor's claim: "Personalize every email with purchase history, browsing behavior, and predicted value"; its Personalization add-on is measured, the vendor says, "against a holdout group". MCP tools create segments, render templates with context and read campaign reports. Measured by nobody else.

Vendor's claim, second claimant after livevariant: AI-powered experimentation "takes it from there, sending the version most likely to resonate with each subscriber". An MCP tool adds a campaign variation behind beta=true. No page read names the winner-choice method. Measured by nobody else.
